name: Soft Pretzels
summary: Alkaline bath, deep mahogany crust, coarse salt.

steps.text: Mix a stiff dough and knead until smooth.
Bulk one hour, then roll long ropes and twist.
Chill the shaped pretzels 30 minutes to firm up.
Dip in the alkaline bath, salt, slash, and bake immediately.

bake.notes: Baked soda works safely at home. Real lye needs gloves and care.

notes: Chilling before the bath keeps the shape crisp.
